The chicken is a roasted thigh or drumstick portion, about 9 cm by 7 cm. I estimate it at about 120 g with the bone. Roasted chicken with skin runs about 220 kcal per 100 g, so this is roughly 200 kcal, and some of that weight is bone.

The arugula is a small pile of about 20 g, which adds only about 5 kcal. If it carries a little dressing, that might add 20 kcal.

Together that comes to about 140 g of food and roughly 230 kcal.
